scope: offline automatic unit integration immutable-source adversarial logging and green-checkpoint gates
method: M20 composes the existing sealed component gates, verifies immutable framework source materialization, adds M19/M20 accounting and permits a source checkpoint only after every earlier automatic gate is green. Hardware gates remain manual and unaddressed.

guarantees: shell, Python and JSON syntax are audited before heavier gates; CMake paths are configured by bounded component runners
limitations: syntax success is not target runtime evidence
tests: test-infrastructure is first in the canonical runner

guarantees: git diff whitespace validation covers the live framework and public documentation scope
limitations: untracked source hygiene is additionally enforced by test_infrastructure
tests: diff-check is an automatic gate

guarantees: safe host parsers run under ASan/UBSan and a bounded synthetic fuzz corpus
limitations: only host-safe parsers enter automatic fuzz execution
tests: nxloader host reports compiler, sanitizer and fuzz coverage

guarantees: nxcompat policy, registry and fake SDL boundaries run in owned temporary trees
limitations: real backends remain outside the host gate
tests: GCC and Clang sanitizer builds are automatic

guarantees: nxgl context, present, metrics and diagnostics tests use sealed fake providers without opening a desktop
limitations: physical GLES evidence remains a later hardware milestone
tests: native video tests stay non-automatic

guarantees: pure input policy and fake nxcompat bridge tests run with native controller enumeration disabled
limitations: physical controller tests remain hardware-class
tests: nxinput static, bridge and M15 contract gates are automatic

guarantees: nxloader executes synthetic ELF, relocation, failure and fuzz fixtures only
limitations: approved guest ELFs remain read-only evidence or isolated cross gates
tests: host, ARMv7 cross and AArch64 cross gates are separate

guarantees: NXExtract regressions operate below owned temporary roots and the release set is pinned
limitations: tests use synthetic archives and data
tests: Python, runtime environment, audit and release gates are automatic

guarantees: nxrelease validate, stage, bundle and verify tests stay inside a temporary stage
limitations: the fixture ZIP is not a game release
tests: M18 closure and adversarial nxrelease suite are automatic

guarantees: nxbootstrap manifest and generator tests use synthetic files and no guest process
limitations: synthetic lifecycle execution is separately contained in the process-class gate
tests: static safety runs before isolated lifecycle

guarantees: the only automatic signal integration requires sealed user, PID and mount namespaces
limitations: namespace unavailability fails closed or skips with explicit status
tests: watchdog targets one owned child by PID and starttime

guarantees: phase failures preserve status and PortMaster finish/cleanup remain exactly-once
limitations: engine-owned shutdown remains adapter-specific
tests: success, early failure, interruption and repeated cleanup are covered

guarantees: symlink, hardlink and deterministic TOCTOU attacks fail without publishing through the victim
limitations: host filesystem primitives are required for release publication
tests: launcher, runtime, stage, archive and checksum races are exercised

guarantees: global per-port locks and no-replace release races are deterministic and fail closed
limitations: automatic gates never search for or signal an unrelated instance
tests: two port roots share a lock and competing publishers cannot overwrite

guarantees: lost executable bits are handled through explicit interpreters and locks stay off game-data filesystems
limitations: the host gate simulates FAT/exFAT semantics and does not mount a real FAT volume
tests: mode-less helpers and game-root lock rejection are covered

guarantees: every generated Linux ELF in release scope is inventoried and checked against the public glibc ceiling
limitations: original Android BYO payloads are excluded from public packaging
tests: fresh ARMHF/AArch64 fixtures and full nxrelease ELF closure are gated

guarantees: two clean ELF builds and two clean ZIP builds are byte-compared
framework sources are selected by full commit and canonical component digest, reconstructed from cryptographically verified Git objects and revalidated before build use
limitations: game-specific assets require their own release receipt
ports migrate to immutable source snapshots explicitly and must mount the verified snapshot read-only for compilation
tests: M17 determinism, M18 archive determinism and the nxgenerator immutable source gate are automatic

guarantees: each automatic command receives a durable redacted log, result and SHA-256 manifest
limitations: ambient secrets are deliberately not captured
tests: the tooling gate reopens and verifies each manifest format

guarantees: the canonical green set ends with one append-only source checkpoint outside the repository
limitations: a failed earlier gate intentionally produces no green checkpoint
tests: checkpoint restoration and no-replace behavior are covered by test-tools

guarantees: set -e stops before checkpoint on red and every hardware gate remains non-automatic
limitations: physical work still requires explicit authorization and a separately green local run
tests: M20 closure validates ordering, hardware classification and zero physical authority
